Vehicle Profile action cards all render and navigate: act-timeline→/timeline (7 filter chips tl-filter-all/diagnostics/maintenance/performance/repairs/parts/notes all present, filter narrows list, counts reflect totals), act-predictions→/predictions (10 service cards pred-oil/tires/airfilter/brakes/plugs/battery/trans/coolant/belts/alternator with life bar + urgency pill DUE SOON/OK + confidence % + reasons — spark plugs correctly showed DUE SOON with P03xx misfire reason), act-trends→/trends (findings list, 4 SVG charts trend-chart-battery/coolant/health/maxSpeed, HEALTH SCORE chart drew rising line, btn-explain triggered GPT-5.4 explanation which populated trend-explanation with 'Health score rising (+7 over 4 sessions)' assessment), act-repairs→/repair-log (add-repair opens modal, all 6 fields repair-input-title/parts/labor/mileage/cost/detail present + save-repair persists — new TEST_UI_Repair card appeared with mileage 68,000 km and $300 cost badges), act-report→/health-report (empty state 'No report generated yet' + btn-generate present), act-sessions→/recordings?vehicle_id=. Garage tab: vehicle-dash strip renders with HEALTH 85, LAST SCAN today, LAST DRIVE —, SERVICE today, Next: Spark Plugs, and 'Spark Plugs' alert pill. All 38 frontend UI checks passed. No red screen errors. Only cosmetic RN-web warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) carried over from prior iterations. No new deprecated Expo packages detected.

action_items: OPTIONAL (cosmetic, carried over): Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow across styles.

CONSIDER: /api/vehicles/{id}/health-report GET spec says 'returns latest (report:null when none)'. Implementation returns exactly {"report": null} when none — verified. However, non-empty response returns full doc with 'report' string field alongside id/predictions/trends — that matches the frontend contract.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:811 _gather_vehicle — Single async pull of vehicle + history + reports + recordings; scoped by user_id everywhere (auth-safe). Reports are matched by either vehicle_id OR VIN regex — good for legacy string-vehicle reports.

server.py:845 _compute_predictions — Heuristic engine handles 10 services with keyword matching against maintenance/parts/repair titles. Correctly bumps confidence when meta.mileage is present. Sensor-based urgency overrides (battery<12.2V, coolant>104°C, plugs+P03xx, alternator<12.0V) all reasonable. Sorted overdue-first — verified.

server.py:938 _compute_trends — Uses least-squares slope via _slope helper (correct math). Findings only added when >=3 data points — verified. maxSpeed key in series (not 'maxspeed') — matches frontend contract.

server.py:1000 _timeline_events — Merges reports (diagnostics), recordings (performance), and vehicle_history into unified event stream sorted desc by ts. Filter narrows events but counts always reflect totals — verified.
server.py:315 add_history — Correctly accepts new kinds ('repair', 'note') alongside existing (maintenance/parts/dtc). 400 for invalid kind — verified.

server.py:1139 create_health_report — Persists to vehicle_reports collection with predictions+trends snapshot. GPT-5.4 with graceful 500 on failure. GET returns latest via sort=[('created_at', -1)] — good pattern.
server.py:1105 explain_trends — Graceful early-return when no findings (returns 200 with friendly message instead of 500 or empty AI) — verified.
server.py:1044 timeline filter — Filter comparison against event['group'] (not event['type']); works because kind_map maps repair→'repairs', note→'notes' etc. Correct.

Note: server.py is now 1197 lines — approaching the 700-line advisory limit. Consider splitting Vehicle Intelligence engine (predictions/trends/timeline/dashboard/health-report) into a submodule for maintainability, though this is not blocking.
